theme.localOverrides: data-theme on a subtree; custom portals copy the nearest theme/accent/borders and establish raised surface context

surface.customContainer: Set background:var(--cap-surface-current) to match the declared surface
affects: neutral control fills and hover/active states

borders.effect: off makes decorative boundaries transparent; on restores boundaries and quieter neutral control fills without changing geometry

sizes.note: at 16px root; touch targets expand separately; ActionBar and ButtonGroup size coordinate nested controls, while popup content keeps its own size

accent.compatibility: data-color is an alias; gray aliases neutral

tokens.architecture: Base Figma graph: 12 fixed neutral variables + 12 shared accent variables across 18 modes + 24 light/dark roles. CSS adds explicit inherited surface/border context; that runtime layer is not included in the 48-variable graph.
tokens.compatibility: --cap-bg-*, --cap-text-* and established border aliases remain available. Full original per-hue/editor palettes are opt-in legacy audit data.

Button.props: variant?: primary|secondary|outline|ghost|danger|accent; size?: xs|sm|md|lg; loading?: boolean; leading?, trailing?: ReactNode; native button props
Button.behavior: type=button by default; loading disables repeat activation. Neutral secondary fills use inherited surface/border context; accent variant inherits the nearest accent mode.

Icon.props: name: IconName; size?: number; SVG props

Badge.props: color?: Color; variant?: soft|solid|outline; children; span props
Badge.behavior: Omitting color inherits the nearest data-accent mode.

Tag.props: color?: Color; onRemove?: () => void; children; span props
Tag.behavior: Omitting color inherits the nearest data-accent mode; removable tags add a separately labeled button.

TypeLabel.props: icon?: IconName; color?: Color; children; span props
TypeLabel.behavior: Omitting color inherits the nearest data-accent mode.

IconBox.props: icon: IconName; color?: Color; size?: xs|sm|md|lg
IconBox.behavior: Omitting color inherits the nearest data-accent mode.

Avatar.props: name: string; src?: string; size?: xs|sm|md|lg

Progress.props: label: string; value: number (clamped 0–100); div props

Input.purpose: Native text, date, time, file and other input types
Input.props: size?: xs|sm|md|lg; native input props except numeric size; ref

Select.purpose: Custom single-select popup with native form backing
Select.props: value?, defaultValue?: string|number; onValueChange?: (value: string) => void; options?: {value,label,disabled?,group?}[] or option children; size?: Size; placeholder?; native single-select props; ref: HTMLSelectElement
Select.behavior: Arrows/Home/End and typeahead navigate; Enter/Space choose; Escape dismisses. Hidden native select preserves form values, required validation, reset and change events.

Field.props: label: string; hint?, error?: string; required?: boolean; children: props => ReactNode

Checkbox.props: label: ReactNode; indeterminate?: boolean; native input props

Radio.props: label: ReactNode; native input props; shared name per group

SegmentedControl.props: label: string; value: string; onValueChange: (value) => void; options: {value,label,disabled?,icon?}[]

Card.behavior: Own surface is raised for default/elevated and canvas for subtle; nested controls use that context. Decorative borders follow data-borders.

ObjectCard.props: title: string; description?: string; icon?: IconName; color?: Color; meta?, cover?: ReactNode; button props

CollectionRow.props: title: string; icon?: IconName; color?: Color; meta?: ReactNode; button props

SidebarItem.props: icon?: IconName; active?: boolean; count?: number; children; button props

PropertyRow.props: label: string; icon?: IconName; children; div props

Breadcrumbs.props: items: {label,href?}[]; label?: string (unique across multiple navs)

Callout.props: color?: Color; icon?: IconName; title?: string; children; div props

EmptyState.props: title: string; icon?: IconName; description?: string; action?: ReactNode

Accordion.props: title: ReactNode; children; native details props

Tabs.props: label: string; value: string; onValueChange: (value) => void; variant?: line|pills; items: {value,label,content,disabled?}[]
Tabs.behavior: Arrows/Home/End skip disabled tabs; one active tab stop. Values must be unique and the active value valid.

Table.purpose: Static data table with scroll region
Table.props: caption: string; columns: string[]; rows: ReactNode[][]; className?

Dialog.purpose: Custom inset modal with backdrop and focus restoration
Dialog.props: open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open) => void; title: string; description?: string; children; footer?: ReactNode; size?: sm|md|lg; closeLabel?: string; dismissOnOutside?: boolean
Dialog.behavior: Controlled custom portal; Tab trapping, Escape, focus restoration, inert background and scroll locking. Own surface is raised; nearest theme/accent/borders are preserved. Overlay gutter is 12px.

Drawer.purpose: Inset side panel with modal behavior
Drawer.behavior: Same modal contract as Dialog, with left/right/bottom placement.

Tooltip.purpose: Portaled hover/focus hint with optional keycaps
Tooltip.props: content: ReactNode; shortcut?: string[]; children: one focusable ReactElement forwarding aria-describedby
Tooltip.example: <Tooltip content="Focus mode" shortcut={["⇧", "⌘", "M"]}><IconButton label="Focus mode" icon="grid" /></Tooltip>
Tooltip.behavior: Hover or focus shows the hint; Escape dismisses; keycaps are decorative hints, not registered shortcuts.

Menu.props: label: string; icon?: IconName; disabled?: boolean; size?: Size; variant?: ButtonProps.variant; items: {id,label,icon?,shortcut?,disabled?,danger?,separator?,onSelect?}[]
Menu.behavior: Arrows/Home/End/typeahead skip disabled entries; Escape restores trigger focus; outside pointer dismisses.

Popover.purpose: Custom anchored information or form popup
Popover.props: label: string; children: ReactNode; open?: boolean; onOpenChange?: (open) => void; align?: start|center|end; side?: top|bottom; disabled?: boolean; size?: Size (trigger only)
Popover.behavior: Optional controlled state; Escape/outside dismiss; position is clamped to viewport gutters. Own raised surface preserves theme/accent/borders. size affects the trigger; popup content does not inherit toolbar sizing.

CommandPalette.purpose: Local command search in a modal
CommandPalette.props: open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open) => void; items: {id,label,description?,icon?,shortcut?,onSelect}[]; placeholder?: string
CommandPalette.behavior: Filters locally; arrows select, Enter activates, Escape dismisses. The consumer registers any global shortcut.

Toast.props: title: string; description?: string; onDismiss?: () => void; div props

ScrollArea.purpose: Native scroll viewport with themed scrollbar and overflow shadows
ScrollArea.props: label: string; axis?: vertical|horizontal|both; scrollbar?: auto|hidden (default hidden for horizontal, auto otherwise); shadows?: boolean; viewportProps?, viewportClassName?, contentClassName?; onEdgesChange?: ({top,right,bottom,left}) => void; ref: scrolling div; root div props
ScrollArea.behavior: Set a height or constrained parent for vertical overflow. Native wheel/touch/keyboard scrolling remains with scrollbar=auto or hidden. Horizontal defaults hidden; vertical/both auto. Edge masks reveal existing background, not a tinted overlay. Ref and viewportProps target the scrolling node.

ButtonGroup.props: label: string; attached?: boolean; size?: Size; orientation?: horizontal|vertical; prefix?: ReactNode; children; div props
ButtonGroup.example: <ButtonGroup label="View" prefix={count}><IconButton label="List" icon="list" /><IconButton label="Grid" icon="grid" /></ButtonGroup>
ButtonGroup.behavior: Groups real buttons without nesting them; each button retains native keyboard behavior. size sets the outer height including attached-group padding; omitted size inherits the enclosing ActionBar or defaults to md.

SplitButton.purpose: Primary action and separate custom action menu
SplitButton.props: label: string; menuLabel?: string; items: MenuItem[]; ButtonProps except children/trailing
SplitButton.behavior: Main action and menu are separate buttons; disabled/loading disables both.

ActionBar.props: label: string; size?: Size; orientation?: horizontal|vertical; rovingFocus?: boolean (default true); children; div props
ActionBar.behavior: One tab stop by default; arrows/Home/End move across enabled actions. size unifies nested button/input heights; nested groups can override it. Set rovingFocus=false for forms and complex controls.

FloatingActionBar.behavior: Positioning stays inside its container; it does not install a fixed viewport overlay. Uses raised surface context and inherited border mode; accepts ActionBar size.

FloatingField.purpose: Input with persistent inside label and linked validation
FloatingField.props: label: string; hint?: ReactNode; error?: string; leading?, trailing?: ReactNode; inputClassName?; native input props except size; ref: input
FloatingField.behavior: Label/id, help/error descriptions and native required/disabled behavior are wired automatically.

StatusBar.props: tone?: neutral|info|success|warning|danger; variant?: plain|surface (default plain); leading?, trailing?: ReactNode; busy?: boolean; children; div props
StatusBar.behavior: role=status with polite announcements; busy marks in-progress work. variant=plain is transparent by default; surface adds a context-aware fill.

Alert.purpose: Status or alert with optional disclosure and dismissal
Alert.props: title: ReactNode; tone?: FeedbackTone; icon?: ReactNode; expandable?: boolean; expanded?, defaultExpanded?: boolean; onExpandedChange?: (expanded) => void; onDismiss?: () => void; dismissLabel?: string; children; div props
Alert.example: <Alert tone="success" title="Saved" expandable defaultExpanded>All changes are stored locally.</Alert>
Alert.behavior: Optional controlled/uncontrolled expansion; collapsed content is inert and hidden from assistive technology. Dismiss button is separate from disclosure.

SidebarPanel.purpose: Sidebar with fixed header/footer and scrollable middle
SidebarPanel.props: label: string; header?, footer?: ReactNode; width?: CSSProperties.width; children; aside props
SidebarPanel.behavior: Constrain its height; header/footer stay outside the middle ScrollArea. Own surface is canvas.

Calendar.purpose: Monday-first 6-week calendar with optional daily agenda
Calendar.props: onValueChange: (YYYY-MM-DD) => void; value?, defaultMonth?, today?, min?, max?: string; isDateUnavailable?: (date) => boolean; locale?: string; events?: {id,date,title,time?,color?}[]; showAgenda?: boolean; yearRange?: [number,number]; label?
Calendar.behavior: Local date strings, Monday-first grid. Arrows move by day/week; Home/End by week; PageUp/PageDown by month (Shift: year); Enter/Space selects enabled dates.

DatePicker.purpose: Calendar inside a custom dismissible popover
DatePicker.props: CalendarProps; label defaults to date-picker label
DatePicker.behavior: Uses Calendar in a custom Popover and closes after selection; no system date picker.

MarkdownPreview.behavior: Supports headings, paragraphs, emphasis, links, lists/tasks, quotes, code and dividers. Escapes HTML and filters link protocols; not a full CommonMark parser.

MarkdownEditor.purpose: Controlled Markdown textarea with formatting and preview
MarkdownEditor.props: value: string; onValueChange: (value) => void; label: string; placeholder?: string; disabled?, readOnly?: boolean; defaultMode?: edit|preview|split; onSave?: () => void
MarkdownEditor.example: <MarkdownEditor label="Daily note" value={note} onValueChange={setNote} defaultMode="split" onSave={save} />
MarkdownEditor.behavior: Cmd/Ctrl+B and I format selection; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter calls onSave. State/persistence belongs to the consumer; edit/preview/split modes are local.

ContentCard.purpose: Configurable article card with independent controls
ContentCard.props: title: ReactNode; description?, header?, metadata?, footer?, cover?, actions?: ReactNode; onOpen?: () => void; selected?: boolean; onSelectedChange?: (selected) => void; selectionLabel?; density?: compact|comfortable; orientation?: vertical|horizontal; headingLevel?: 2|3|4; article props
ContentCard.example: <ContentCard title="Project" description="Next steps" onOpen={open} selected={selected} onSelectedChange={setSelected} actions={<Menu label="Project actions" items={actions} />} />
ContentCard.behavior: Article composition permits independent checkboxes/buttons/links. Own surface is raised. onOpen makes the title an action; the whole card is not a button.

TaskCard.purpose: Task article with completion and action menu
TaskCard.props: title: string; typeLabel?: string; color?: Color (default rose); completed?: boolean; onCompletedChange?: (completed) => void; menuItems?: MenuItem[]; other ContentCardProps except title/header/actions
TaskCard.example: <TaskCard title="Plan the week" completed={done} onCompletedChange={setDone} metadata={<Tag>Personal</Tag>} />
TaskCard.behavior: Completion, title action and menu are independent controls. Consumer owns completed state.

KanbanColumn.purpose: Named column with count, action and empty state
KanbanColumn.props: title: string; count?: number; action?, emptyState?: ReactNode; children; section props

KanbanBoard.purpose: Controlled task lanes with menu-based movement
KanbanBoard.props: label: string; columns: {id,title,emptyMessage?}[]; items: {id,columnId,title,description?,completed?,color?,metadata?,footer?}[]; onMove?: (id,columnId) => void; onCompletedChange?: (id,completed) => void; onOpen?: (id) => void; onAdd?: (columnId) => void; renderCard?: (item) => ReactNode
KanbanBoard.behavior: Consumer owns columns/items/moves. Default cards expose target-column actions in a keyboard-accessible menu; no drag-and-drop runtime.

DailyHeader.purpose: Localized date, weekday and ISO week header
DailyHeader.props: date: YYYY-MM-DD; locale?: string; showWeek?: boolean; tags?, actions?: ReactNode; headingLevel?: 1|2|3; children; header props
DailyHeader.example: <DailyHeader date="2026-09-25" tags={<TypeLabel color="rose">Tasks</TypeLabel>} actions={<Button onClick={create}>New note</Button>} />
DailyHeader.behavior: Uses local YYYY-MM-DD dates and ISO week numbering; locale defaults to ru-RU.

constraints: Use styles.css once; fonts are opt-in; no runtime dependencies beyond React peers
Prefer shared semantic roles and data-accent to per-hue tokens
Set global theme/borders on html; use explicit matching data-surface on custom containers; portals preserve local theme/accent/borders and use raised surface
Do not nest interactive elements inside ObjectCard or CollectionRow; use ContentCard for independent actions
Table does not sort or paginate by itself
Toast placement/lifetime, persistence, and global shortcuts belong to the consumer
Calendar/DatePicker replace system date UI; plain Input retains native input-type behavior
Source CSS and full original palettes are legacy audit data; read only when needed
Install a built .tgz from local pack or a release asset when available; git install is not supported because dist is ignored and prepare is absent
